description: This file defines an abstract base class for creating enumeration types in PHP. It provides mechanisms for handling enum values, keys, serialization, comparison, and reflection-based retrieval of constants. The class is designed to be extended by user-defined enums which declare constants representing enum options.

classes.name: Enum
classes.description: An abstract base class for enum types that provides functionality for enum value management, comparison, serialization, and reflection-based constant retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the enum instance with a value, converting it if necessary, and validates it.

methods.name: __wakeup
methods.description: Method invoked during deserialization to restore the enum's key based on its value.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates an enum instance from a given value, throwing an exception if invalid.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the enum instance.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key (constant name) associated with the enum instance.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the enum value.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if this enum instance is equal to another variable based on value and class.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Returns all constant keys defined in the enum class.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns all enum instances for the class constants.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns an associative array of constant names to their values, cached per class.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if a value is a valid enum value.

methods.name: assertValidValue
methods.description: Asserts that a value is a valid enum value, throwing an exception if not.

methods.name: assertValidValueReturningKey
methods.description: Internal method that returns the key for a valid value, throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: isValidKey
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid key (constant name) in the enum.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Finds the key for a given value, or returns false if not found.

methods.name: __callStatic
methods.description: Allows static method calls to instantiate enum instances based on constant names, caching instances.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Prepares the enum instance for JSON serialization, returning its value.
